StudentProfile.title: StudentProfile
StudentProfile.description: Stores Zein El-Din's adaptive learning level, gamification stars, streak, and study reminder preferences.

studentName.description: Display name of the student (e.g., زين الدين آسر الشربيني).

gradeLabel.description: Grade description (e.g., الصف الثاني الابتدائي لغات).

studentLevel.description: Adaptive learning level: beginner (مبتدئ) or advanced (متقدم).

completedLessonsCount.description: Total number of curriculum lessons completed.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily lesson review notifications are enabled.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CurriculumLesson.title: CurriculumLesson
CurriculumLesson.description: Official grounded curriculum lesson (Subject -> Unit -> Lesson) extracted from school PDF books for Egyptian Primary 2 Language Schools (2026/2027).

subjectId.description: Identifier for the 5 official subjects (Discover/اكتشف is excluded per 2026/2027 update).

subjectNameAr.description: Arabic display title of the subject.

lessonOrder.description: Order of the lesson within the subject.

officialContent.description: Strict grounding text extracted from the official curriculum PDF.

keyTerms.description: Key bilingual or Arabic vocabulary terms from the lesson.

sourceBookName.description: Name of the source PDF book or official module.

isCompleted.description: Whether Zein El-Din has completed studying and answering this lesson.

lastAiExplanation.description: Optional cached chalkboard explanation generated by the AI teacher.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the lesson was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the lesson was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Stores conversation history messages between Zein El-Din and the AI Tutor (chat queries, quizzes, exams, and concise revisions grounded on all uploaded PDFs).

sender.description: Sender of the message: 'user' (Zein El-Din) or 'ai' (AI Tutor).

messageText.description: Text of the query, explanation, quiz, exam, or concise revision.

subjectFilter.description: Curriculum subject filter active for this message.

interactionMode.description: Type of tutor interaction: chat, quiz, exam, or revision.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/profile/{profileId}.description: Stores the student profile and gamification state for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/lessons/{lessonId}.description: Stores the grounded PDF curriculum lessons for the 5 official Grade 2 subjects.

/users/{userId}/chat_messages/{messageId.description: Stores the persistent AI tutor conversation history (questions, answers, quizzes, exams, and revisions).
